customManagers.description: HAProxy pinned-patch image tags in dev-env manifests. Series-locked: the major.minor is captured from the current tag and baked into the versioning regex, so each manifest stays within its own series.

HAProxy patch versions in charts/haptic/values.yaml. Each entry's series (captured from the YAML key) is baked into a per-dep regex versioning scheme, so Renovate only considers patches within the same series. Adding or removing a series requires no renovate.json change.

SPOA hub bundle versions in versions-spoa.env. Each entry has a `# renovate:` comment naming the upstream GitLab Generic Package, optionally followed by free-form `#` notes documenting the bump, then a `<NAME>_VERSION="vX.Y.Z"` assignment. The intermediate `(?:#[^\n]*\n)*` group allows any number of comment lines between the renovate directive and the assignment so the file stays readable as the metric set + behaviour notes grow. The shipped customManagers:gitlabPipelineVersions preset only matches .gitlab-ci.yml so we need a dedicated manager for this file.

Vector sidecar image tag in charts/haptic/values.yaml. The tag carries a distro suffix (e.g. 0.57.0-debian), so the versioning scheme captures the semver part and keeps the suffix out of the comparison; without it Renovate treats the whole string as an unparseable version and never proposes a bump. The `# renovate:` comment must sit directly above the `tag:` line.

Varnish image tag, in every file that pins one. The value is a bare `image: <repo>:<tag>` string, which Renovate's built-in helm-values manager does not recognise (it looks for an image.repository + image.tag pair), so this pin needs an explicit manager or it is never bumped. All five pins must move together: values.yaml is what deploys, preflight.go is the varnishd that compiles the VCL in the gate, and constants.go is the image e2e preloads into kind. Bumping values.yaml alone left the others two majors behind on an EOL release. The pattern matches a `renovate:` comment line followed by the pin on the next line, in any file type — keep them adjacent.

Valkey image tag, in every file that pins one, for the same reason as the Varnish manager above: values.yaml was bumped to 9-alpine while the annotation-library default, its snippet fallback, and the e2e preload stayed on 8-alpine. Same comment-anchored pattern — a `renovate:` line immediately above the pin.

packageRules.description: Group Go version updates from go.mod and .tool-versions
Group all HAProxy image/patch bumps into a single MR per run

Keep HAPROXY_VERSION ARGs on stable series only. Docker Hub's floating `X.Y` tag can point at a dev release before the first `X.Y.Z` patch ships (e.g. `3.4` → `3.4-dev2`), so derive the tracked version from patch tags. Covers both the `ARG HAPROXY_VERSION=` lines and the `FROM haproxytech/haproxy-debian:${HAPROXY_VERSION}` lines that Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager extracts by resolving the ARG — both need the clamp, across all three files.

Keep HAPROXY_VERSION in the CI image Dockerfile on stable series only. Upstream haproxy/haproxy tags are `vX.Y-devN` during development and `vX.Y.Z` at release; deriving the version from patch tags skips series that have no stable release yet.

Group all SPOA hub bundle bumps (hub + 6 plugins) into a single MR per run so the bundle moves forward atomically. No auto-merge: these bumps re-validate the supply-chain prep job and the smoke test, so a human should review at least until the bundle has been stable for a release cycle.
